description: This file contains implementation of big number shift operations (left shift and right shift) for cryptographic computations, specifically for the BIGNUM data structure used in OpenSSL.

methods.name: BN_lshift
methods.description: Performs a left shift operation on a BIGNUM by n bits.

methods.name: BN_rshift
methods.description: Performs a right shift operation on a BIGNUM by n bits.
